# tcs-storyboard

Converts a finished lesson script into the render-agnostic `<lesson>.storyboard.json` — picks a kit template per scene with schema-valid props, b-roll queries, text-free generated-image prompts, cast, voices, theme and aspect, derives on-screen text, validates cues/claims/board sizes, and prints a markdown preview table for the lesson-1 approval gate.

Part of the **[Training Content Studio](../training-content-studio/README.md)** plugin.

## What it's for
`storyboard.json` is the single contract every renderer consumes (Remotion/OpenMontage video, deck, HTML lesson, SCORM,
job aid). This skill makes it complete, valid and reviewable, with all on-screen text in template props.

## When to use it
- Use to turn a script into a storyboard JSON — "storyboard this", "convert the script into scenes", "choose the visuals/templates", "show me the storyboard preview", or "fix the storyboard validation errors".
- **Not for:** writing or retiming narration (tcs-scriptwriter), rendering (tcs-render-*) or translating (tcs-localize).

## Install
```bash
# whole plugin (recommended: scripts use the shared schemas/, kit/, assets/)
git clone https://github.com/TamerElsherif/tamer-skills && claude --plugin-dir tamer-skills/training-content-studio
# this skill only (instructions only; its scripts need the plugin root)
npx skills add TamerElsherif/tamer-skills --skill tcs-storyboard --agent claude-code
```
Prerequisites: Python 3.12 venv with `tools/requirements.txt` (plugin root); keys via env or `TCS_ENV_FILE` (`OPENAI_API_KEY` for narration/transcription, `PEXELS_API_KEY` optional); Node 18+ and ffmpeg for video renders.

## How to use
```
/tcs-storyboard <request or file>
```
**Inputs**

- Script stage `runs/<run>/lessons/<lesson_id>/<lesson_id>.storyboard.json` (from tcs-scriptwriter: narration + claims, placeholder
  `statement` templates, `notes: "script-stage: … hint=…"`) or a `script.md`.
- Format playbook `skills/tcs-format-<format>/references/playbook.md` (beat → template map, pacing).
- `schemas/storyboard.schema.json`, `schemas/enums.json` (templates, poses, expressions, sets).
- Personas `assets/characters/personas.yaml` + `domains/<pack>/personas.yaml`; voices `assets/voices.yaml`;
  theme `assets/theme_presets.yaml`; domain mock-up presets `domains/<pack>/mockups.yaml`.
- `<lesson_id>.quiz.json` (for `quiz` scenes) if tcs-assessment ran.

**Outputs**

- `runs/<run>/lessons/<lesson_id>/<lesson_id>.storyboard.json` (final stage, schema-valid, lint-clean).
- `runs/<run>/lessons/<lesson_id>/<lesson_id>.preview.md` — preview table (lesson 1 is shown at the approval gate).

## Examples
**Example 1: Storyboard a script**
Prompt: `turn the M1L1 script into a storyboard`
Result: Chooses one of 32 templates per scene with schema-valid props, b-roll queries and text-free image prompts; validates; prints the preview table.

**Example 2: Fix validation**
Prompt: `fix the storyboard validation errors`
Result: Runs validate_storyboard.py and repairs cue counts, board sizes, missing claims.

## Layout
```
tcs-storyboard/
  SKILL.md
  references/
    template-guide.md
    visual-rules.md
  scripts/

```
